company.name: yhangry
company.shortDescription: Yhangry is a private chef marketplace, where you can book a chef whenever you want to socialise at home.
company.description: Yhangry is a private chef marketplace, where you can book a chef whenever you want to socialise at home. For $40pp, you can book a 3-course feast in just a few clicks. On the supply side, we help chefs earn 3 times as much as working in a restaurant.

productsAndServices.description: A platform to book private chefs for events at home or rented venues across the UK and the US, providing personalized menus and quotes from multiple chefs.
productsAndServices.name: Private Chef Booking Service

productsAndServices.description: A feature enabling customers to receive multiple personalized menu proposals and quotes from chefs and communicate directly to customize their event menus.
productsAndServices.name: Chef Quote and Menu Customization

productsAndServices.description: A payment system that holds funds in escrow until after the event, ensuring secure transactions and protection against no-shows or cancellations.
productsAndServices.name: Secure Payment and Booking Protection

productsAndServices.description: Insurance coverage that protects customers against accidents caused by chefs during events booked through the platform.
productsAndServices.name: Public Liability Insurance Coverage

productsAndServices.description: A cancellation policy allowing full refunds up to seven days before the event and assistance with rebooking if a chef cancels.
productsAndServices.name: Flexible Cancellation and Refund Policy

productsAndServices.description: Payment options allowing customers to pay a 10% deposit or split the bill among guests for bookings made more than five weeks in advance.
productsAndServices.name: Split Bill and Deposit Payment Options

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Equity Crowdfunding round raised $900,798, or 37.52% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $8,408,389 to $13,037,053, a 1.55x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 58 (-2 over 90 days) and market heat at 64 (-4).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set

insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
